First public release of **Blind Pew**, an offline transliteration switcher for Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04 with GNOME or Xfce.

The application version is **0.1.0**; the Debian package revision is **0.1.0-2**, so existing 0.1.0-1 installations upgrade normally.

- Seven languages, eight transliteration profiles and QWERTY/QWERTZ bases.
- F12 and tray-wheel switching between the selected transliteration and the previous ordinary input source.
- Native GTK settings, live preview, offline CLI and 49 interface catalogs.
- Fixes for duplicate IBus initialization on Ubuntu, shared GTK/IBus connection shutdown, fresh Xfce shortcuts and missing package dependencies.
- Bounded and validated preferences, atomic settings/icon writes, preserved shortcut backups and streaming CLI conversion.

Download both `blind-pew_0.1.0-2_all.deb` and `SHA256SUMS`, then run in their folder:

```sh
sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS
sudo apt install ./blind-pew_0.1.0-2_all.deb
```

Log out and back in, then open **Blind Pew** from the application menu. GNOME needs the supplied **Blind Pew Integration** extension and an AppIndicator extension. Xfce needs a tray panel item.

The release comes from commit `fcd66d7577e4053a6a2c1b71c2374ecd8190f940`. [All five CI jobs passed](https://github.com/gagafes/blind-pew/actions/runs/41887476222): package lifecycle and reproducibility, real GNOME/Xfce integration, GTK3/GTK4 input, sensitive-field bypass and source/secret scans on Ubuntu 24.04 and Debian 13.

Automated desktops use virtual displays. Qt, Electron, Flatpak/Snap, physical input hardware and native-speaker review of all 49 translations remain outside the confirmed coverage. See the [testing scope](https://github.com/gagafes/blind-pew/blob/v0.1.0-2/docs/TESTING.md).

The original implementation remains MIT-licensed. Transliteration data provenance and third-party terms are documented in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/gagafes/blind-pew/blob/v0.1.0-2/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and the [license review](https://github.com/gagafes/blind-pew/blob/v0.1.0-2/docs/LEGAL_REVIEW.md).
